p, k = map(int, input().split())

parent = list(range(p))

def findSet(x):
    if parent[x] == x:
        return x
    parent[x] = findSet(parent[x])
    return parent[x]

def unionSets(x, y):
    px = findSet(x)
    py = findSet(y)
    if px != py:
        parent[py] = px

for i in range(1, p):

        unionSets((k * i) % p, i)

unique_parents = set()

    unique_parents.add(findSet(i))

count = p if k == 1 else len(unique_parents)

answer = 1
MOD = 1000000007
for _ in range(count):
    answer = (answer * p) % MOD
